title: Mixed Event — This Way! That Way! Zookeeper Day — Episode1 We're Animal Caretakers!

meta.Event: This Way! That Way! Zookeeper Day
meta.Event Outline: Fresh second-years Minori and Shiho are on the animal caretaker committee, and their work has already begun. When they learn about a shadowing opportunity at Odaiba Animal Land from a teacher, they decide to participate. Animal antics ensue!

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Phew...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
There!
Clean as a whistle!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: The rabbits seem happy about their cage being clean again.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thanks for giving me all those tips for cleaning efficiently, Minori. That helped a lot.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. You're super welcome!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Still, Shiho, you said you were still trying to get the hang of things, but you really knew what you were doing!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: When I first cleaned the cage, I remember flipping over their bowls by accident and slipping on the water...which was pretty embarrassing.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm not sure that has anything to do with knowing how this process works.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Oh, we should start heading back.
We have that committee meeting.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, that's right!
Let's go!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait, we have like no time! We gotta hurry!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Huh...? Wait, Minori!
The meeting's that way!
Vacant Classroom

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: That concludes our activity reports.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line:
Next, announcements for this month...
I have a special bit of news today.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: A special bit of news...?

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line:
Yes.
Please take a look at the last bullet point on the printout I gave you.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: The last bullet point...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait, it says, “Applications to shadow with the caretakers at Odaiba Animal Land”!

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: “Providing an opportunity for students to dive into the world of animal welfare by helping to take care of various creatures.”

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: With that goal in mind, it seems they're accepting applications from students attending any high school in the city.

rows.Speaker: Second-Year A
rows.Line:
Hey, that sounds like fun!
Odaiba Animal Land's a fully indoor zoo, right?

rows.Speaker: Second-Year B
rows.Line:
Yeah, they're pretty rare.
I remember seeing on TV how everyone goes to see the armadillos!

rows.Speaker: First-Year
rows.Line:
Armadillos are so cute!
I've even heard that a lot of people are keeping them as pets now!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wow, really...?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
That does sound like fun!
It's not every day that you get to work with real animals at a real zoo. I might actually apply...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What do you think, Shiho?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, this could be fun.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line:
Please let me know if you're interested.
They'll be accepting applications all through this week.

rows.Speaker: Third-Year A
rows.Line: Hmm... I really wanna go, but I have to take a test at my cram school that day...

rows.Speaker: Third-Year B
rows.Line:
My club's going to a tournament!
I so wish I could go!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I might not be able to go either since our schedule's been so packed lately.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Lemme take another look. This sheet says we'd be going the Saturday after next.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(Wait a second!
If I recall correctly, the job on that day got cancelled.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Where's my planner...?)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Yeah, I'm free! That means...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Shiho, are you free on that day?
If you are, we could go—

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: No, I was thinking about practicing alone that day.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Whaaat?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
B-B-B-B-But...!
You just said that it might be fun...
Would taking a little break be that bad?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And I'm sure all the animals are gonna be super cute! Like, the armadillos and the...uh...armadillos!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Are they your only example...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: M-More importantly... You just said that you're “thinking about” having practice that day. That means you're not fully decided yet, right?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It's gonna be so much fun! I bet you'll even get to hold lots of little critters!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hold...little critters...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Well...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We have been practicing a ton lately, so a break might not be a bad idea...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yay! Woohoo!
We get to take care of animals together!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, excuse me!
We'd both like to take part in the shadowing opportunity!

rows.Speaker: Second-Year A
rows.Line: No fair! I wanna go!

rows.Speaker: Third-Year B
rows.Line: If it weren't for that tournament...

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line:
Ah, excellent.
Then, Hanasato, Hinomori, I'll let them know that you'll be going.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: I'll get back to you on where and when you need to go on the day once all the details have been hammered out.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I, Minori Hanasato, swear to uphold the honor of Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy's animal caretaker committee by doing the best job I can!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, and...
I'm sure Shiho here feels the same way!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Geez...
What am I getting myself into?

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Hehe. I hope you have a fruitful experience.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line:
With that out of the way, that concludes today's meeting.
Thank you all for your time.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thank you!
